newsitem.title: UK: Palladium crisis meeting ends, no details given.
newsitem.headline: Palladium crisis meeting ends, no details given.

text.p: A crisis meeting of London platinum and palladium market-makers ended on Thursday evening but participants declined to say if any decisions had been taken after acute supply shortages sparked fears of defaults.

Several representatives of major precious metals trading firms confirmed the meeting had ended as they left the premises of Standard Bank London. A member of the bank is the current chairman of the London Platinum, Palladium Market association.
But they declined to give any details of the meeting.

Dealers stopped quoting forward rates on Thursday after one-month lease rates soared to 300 percent on Wednesday night. Some traders said they heard talk in the market that there was a possibility of a default on delivery of physical palladium
Prices swung wildly on Thursday, surging to a fresh all-time high fix of $235.00 per ounce, then sliding to fix at $210.00 in the afternoon.
